baseline.name: Original delivery rubric
baseline.description: The team checks whether the requested work was completed, the visible checks passed, and the handoff is understandable.

criteria.label: The patch summary clearly describes the work.

revised.name: Business-boundary rubric
revised.description: Delivery quality still matters, but customer isolation and retry safety are release boundaries.

criteria.label: The patch summary clearly describes the work.
The result must not change another customer account's data.
Retrying the same request must not create another state change or audit event.
If boundary or retry evidence is missing, require human review rather than assuming safety.
